content.short: Meta Assets For Your Metaverse Needs.
content.description:
Meta Assets provides 3D assets for your metaverse needs. We provide Toon low poly model, as well as high AAA Quality photo scan 3D models and assets. Home decorative 3D items, Houses, Luxury Villas, and furniture to decorate your homes. Vehicles to drive around town in the metaverse, and even nature assets like trees and fences for constructing beautiful metaverse surroundings.

There are plans for gaming assets like weapons and wearable equipment and gadgets that are compatible with partnered metaverses. we consider ourselves to be the publisher of 3D NFT assets for your metaverses.

The file format is 3D GLB a 3D file format that's used in Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), games, and web applications. You can also view the NFT in 3D and rotate it in 360 like the viewer in Sketchfab on pool.pm
